SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) AS mth,
       CASE WHEN s.store_id = 999 THEN '999' WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN 'web' ELSE 'store' END AS scope,
       (p.category = 'ZZ Test') AS is_test,
       count(*) AS n_rows, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS n_ids, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS n_rl,
       sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross, sum(f.net_amount) AS net,
       min(f.sale_date) AS d0, max(f.sale_date) AS d1, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores,
       sum(CASE WHEN f.channel_code <> 'ST' OR f.channel_code IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_st
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) AS mth, p.vat_class, f.vat_rate,
       count(*) AS n, sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross, sum(f.net_amount) AS net,
       sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - round(f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate),2)) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatch,
       sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date >= DATE '2024-09-01' AND f.vat_rate = 0.24 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS old_rate_after,
       min(f.sale_date) AS d0, max(f.sale_date) AS d1
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
  AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH mine AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS d, s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS rc
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
    AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1,2),
ctl AS (
  SELECT business_date AS d, store_id, net_sales_before_returns AS cnet, receipts AS crc
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND store_id < 900)
SELECT date_trunc('month', coalesce(m.d, c.d)) AS mth,
       count(*) AS pairs,
       sum(coalesce(m.net,0)) AS my_net, sum(coalesce(c.cnet,0)) AS ctl_net,
       sum(CASE WHEN m.d IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS only_ctl,
       sum(CASE WHEN c.d IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS only_mine,
       sum(CASE WHEN abs(coalesce(m.net,0)-coalesce(c.cnet,0)) > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diff_pairs,
       sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(m.rc,0) <> coalesce(c.crc,0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rc_diff
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON m.d = c.d AND m.store_id = c.store_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT strftime(f.sale_date, '%Y-%m') AS month,
       SUM(f.gross_amount) AS store_sales_incl_vat_before_returns
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
  AND s.store_id < 900
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
